name: Visual-Aesthetic-Benchmark
description:
🍎 Visual Aesthetic Benchmark
	

Visual Aesthetic Benchmark is a large-scale benchmark that evaluates frontier AI models on artist-curated artworks across fine art, photography, and illustration, comparing model judgments against domain-expert evaluations across 400 pairwise comparisons.
13K+ Expert Judgments | 20+ Frontier Models | 2,000+ Hrs Commissioned | 26.5% Highest Performance

🌐 Project Website - Learn more about Visual Aesthetic Benchmark
🔧 GitHub Repo - Evaluation scripts… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/BakeLab/Visual-Aesthetic-Benchmark.
evaluation_method: human_eval (expert pairwise judgments / percent agreement and ranking agreement)
typical_sota_score: ≈26.5% (highest reported model performance on the benchmark)
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face and used in recent model evaluations of aesthetic judgment; visible to the community but not yet a de facto standard benchmark.
